long_biography.plain_text:
Music Box Group revived a long-established European music-television name through a new Polish company formed in 2016, without claiming legal continuity with the original broadcaster. Its model pairs curated video channels with internet distribution, adapting a linear music format for modern viewing across multiple European markets.

Eva Soiref leads that platform as president of the management board and its largest disclosed shareholder. Official broadcasting materials name her as beneficial owner of the company behind Music Box Classic and Music Box Polska. The Polish parent also controls a Czech operating subsidiary used for additional licensed channels, separating Soiref's ownership of the parent from the media services delivered by its companies.
